subject.title: fix(channels): bound draft-stream flush loop to prevent runaway sends

question: May the shipped plugin-SDK `DraftStreamLoop.flush()` resolve after a bounded batch while newer pending text continues asynchronously, or must it preserve a stronger drain-before-return contract?
rationale: The current implementation safely bounds internal work, but the correct completion guarantee for external plugin callers is a compatibility decision that cannot be inferred solely from existing internal finalize paths.

options.title: Define bounded snapshot semantics
options.body: Approve the bounded return behavior, document that concurrent updates may remain scheduled, and add compatibility coverage for callers that finalize or stop after flushing.

options.title: Preserve drain-before-return
options.body: Separate the bounded scheduled pump from the public final flush so callers can still await a guaranteed drain after producers are stopped.

options.title: Pause the SDK change
options.body: Keep the issue open while redesigning the public lifecycle API around explicit pump and finalize operations.

recommendation.title: Define bounded snapshot semantics
recommendation.body: Approve the bounded return behavior, document that concurrent updates may remain scheduled, and add compatibility coverage for callers that finalize or stop after flushing.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice governs a shipped plugin-SDK lifecycle contract and therefore needs release-level compatibility ownership.
